inputs.original_text: Bloomberg: “Every day, as energy prices rise, flights are canceled and death and destruction fill screens, people across the world ask when the Iran war — widely viewed as poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being — will stop.” “Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]
inputs.modified_text: Wake up and stop buying the mainstream line that the screens showing rising energy prices, canceled flights, and constant death and destruction are just a chaotic mess. The hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes want you to believe their official script that the so-called "Iran war" is "poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being," but that is just a carefully managed theater to cover up their real agenda. They try to make you swallow the narrative that people everywhere are supposedly wondering when it will finally stop, but they immediately expose the compliance of the local populations, letting slip that "Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]" That trailing silence is the quiet part they almost said out loud, proving the true, coordinated objectives driving this whole operation forward regardless of whatever stories they feed the manipulated masses.

rationales.contradiction_drift: The modified text contains no clear internal contradiction.
